{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Map arm to treatment
trial_df['treatment'] = trial_df['arm'].map({'control': 'A', 'treatment': 'B'})

# Perform regression to adjust for confounding
# Model: response ~ sex + biomarker_baseline + treatment + interaction terms
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
from statsmodels.regression.linear_model import RegressionResults

# Create a formula for regression
formula = 'responded ~ C(sex) + biomarker_baseline + C(treatment) + C(sex):C(treatment)'

# Fit model
model = ols(formula, data=trial_df).fit()

# Extract coefficient for sex (F vs M)
sex_coeff = model.params['C(sex)[T.F]']
sex_pval = model.pvalues['C(sex)[T.F]']

# Check if treatment effect differs by sex
interaction_coeff = model.params['C(sex)[T.F]:C(treatment)[T.B]']
interaction_pval = model.pvalues['C(sex)[T.F]:C(treatment)[T.B]']

print(f"Sex coefficient (F vs M): {sex_coeff:.4f} (p = {sex_pval:.4f})")
print(f"Sex-by-treatment interaction: {interaction_coeff:.4f} (p = {interaction_pval:.4f})")

# Predicted response rates adjusted for baseline
# Predict for F and M with average biomarker baseline and treatment B
mean_biomarker = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Predict for females
pred_f = model.predict(pd.DataFrame({'sex': ['F'], 'biomarker_baseline': [mean_biomarker], 'treatment': ['B']}))[0]
# Predict for males
pred_m = model.predict(pd.DataFrame({'sex': ['M'], 'biomarker_baseline': [mean_biomarker], 'treatment': ['B']}))[0]

print(f"\nAdjusted response rate (F): {pred_f:.4f}")
print(f"Adjusted response rate (M): {pred_m:.4f}")
print(f"Adjusted difference: {pred_f - pred_m:.4f}")"}
